how_to_apply: Attend the Apprenticeship Mela at ITI Simariya (Chatra) on 10-11-2026 between 10:00 AM and 05:00 PM.
Bring Aadhaar-linked mobile number, PAN Card / Aadhaar / Driving Licence, one passport size photo, email ID, residential certificate and educational documents.
